origin: Original SVG geometry authored in code for this project; no external images, tracing, fonts or samples.
license: CC0-1.0 for these newly authored vector drawings and their PNG renders only.
brief: Nine surreal collectible sculptures: a window holding sky, a book releasing a cloud, a balance weighing sky and stone, a hollow malachite cube, a black bowler holding a cloud, a brass constellation, a key holding sky, an apple mirror and a full-length sky mirror. Black lacquer, malachite, bronze, ivory, soft blue. No text or reproduction of paintings.
variants: sculpture: opaque lacquer and stronger modelling
selection: sculpture selected for solid silhouettes at small hub sizes and legible bronze/green material separation. Study retained, not integrated.
tool: tools/create_collection.mjs; Chromium SVG rasterization to transparent PNG
